title: THiamine for Recovery In Vulnerable Early-life Infections
official: THiamine for Recovery In Vulnerable Early-life Infections
summary: To determine if the addition of thiamine to standard-of-care treatment will improve neurodevelopmental outcomes for infants with meningitis or bacteremia
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. ≤12 months old
2. Clinical concern for bacteremia or meningitis (fever or hypothermia and lethargy; fever or hypothermia and poor feeding; fever or hypothermia and seizure, bulging fontanelle or nuchal rigidity)
3. Legal guardian has provided informed consent
4. No known neurologic or developmental comorbidity (e.g. trisomy 21, congenital structural brain abnormality)
5. Weight ≥ 2kg

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Known neurologic or developmental comorbidity including genetic disorders
2. Weight \< 2 kg
3. Prior episode of bacteremia or meningitis
4. Already receiving thiamine as standard-of-care
